entities.summary: SPARK is a formally defined computer programming language based on the Ada programming language, intended for developing high-integrity software used in systems where predictable and highly reliable operation is essential. It facilitates developing applications that demand safety, security, or business integrity. It has especially found use in real-time computing and embedded systems where issues of safety-criticality or computer security are paramount.
